summary: The task claims to resolve PR #58's PROGRESS.md merge conflict by keeping both appended sections in order (HEAD's work-progress-report section followed by main's company/dept/project dashboard section), but the actual diff does not do that: it deletes all three pre-existing accumulated task sections (resource-management/manpower/material, project-records/permits/drawings/MoMs, and company-dept-project-dashboard-hierarchy -- 272 lines) and replaces them with only a short new entry describing this meta-task itself (22 lines). This both contradicts the repo's own append-only per-task PROGRESS.md convention (which the self-report explicitly invokes) and permanently discards documented history of substantial prior work, including disclosed gaps (unimplemented WhatsApp send, unverified PROJEXA-side tsc/tests, a cross-repo BOQ-amounts dependency awaiting supervisor sign-off) that a human auditor or future worker would need. No .github/workflows/** files are touched, so the hard workflow-scope rule is not implicated, and no schema/migration/auth files are touched either -- tier2 classification here is driven purely by the diff's heavy-deletion shape (>20 lines deleted, >2x insertions), which is a correct, deterministic call given the line counts even though the content is markdown-only. Because the committed diff materially disagrees with the worker's own narrative of what it did, this needs a human to reconcile which version of PROGRESS.md is actually correct before this can be merged.
issues: Diff deletes all 3 pre-existing PROGRESS.md task sections (resource-management, project-records/permits/drawings/MoMs, company-dept-project-dashboard-hierarchy) instead of appending the new section after them as the append-only convention requires.

Self-report explicitly claims 'kept both appended sections in order (HEAD's WPR section, then main's dashboard-hierarchy section)' but the diff shows neither section retained -- only a new unrelated short entry survives. This self-report/diff mismatch needs reconciliation before merge.

Real disclosed follow-up items from the deleted sections (unimplemented WhatsApp integration, unverified PROJEXA-side tsc/test runs, un-pushed compliance-tracker category-boq-amounts branch awaiting sign-off) are now undocumented in PROGRESS.md, risking them being silently dropped.
